A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide the first approach to the AFA problem that can learn a generative surrogate for the target task to guide the agent for feature acquisition, and the first approach for AIR.
we provide a novel approach for active feature acquisition and unsupervised feature selection that is applicable to a variety of real-world scenarios.
we propose a novel framework for active feature acquisition and active instance recognition, and we show that our framework outperforms the current state-of-the-art on both tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed generative surrogate model can be used as a general-purpose model to improve the performance of AFA/AIR tasks.
AFA is a promising approach for improving ML assessments in real-world applications.
